**Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to true. Pool is 20 connections. One per request drains it.

Window: `02:14:18.972Z` to `02:59:27.974Z`. Wrong. Last 503 is `03:59:27.974Z`. That is 1h45m, still open.

New fact worth knowing. After onset, 530 of 636 requests failed. The 106 that passed were all `/health`. That is likely why nobody got paged.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`, or flip that one key to false.
